relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Galcanezumab likely results in a reduction in monthly migraine days.

relationships.subject: Erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Erenumab likely results in a reduction in monthly migraine days.

key_findings: CGRP-pathway mAbs (eptinezumab, erenumab, fremanezumab, galcanezumab) are recommended for episodic and chronic migraine prevention with moderate to high quality evidence.
Erenumab outperformed topiramate with better tolerability in HER-MES.
